paragraphs.source_en: I saw two moons: Same in shape, yet different in face. One at this moment is in the sky, with its robe spread wide in sparrowlike feathers; She does not hold back her grace; the ground below is covered through and through with her gold and silver. She does not forget the glazed glass of the old palace; among the three seas there is her clear and pure beauty. She leaps from the crown of the clouds, leaps up onto the trees, then slips into fresh green vines. So delicate, so beautiful she is, that even the fish beneath the water would be left drunk. Yet she has one flaw: she always loves to waste herself away in the meager and slight. At times all one can see in the sky is a scatter of stars, and the enchanting round face is gone. Though she returns in the end as before, this longing is all but unbearable. And there is also that which you cannot see, even if you do not speak of how dazzling it is. She has her own intoxicated-whirling smile, and the grace she has when she turns. If one speaks of her generosity, she never lets anyone be cheated of it; how I wish you could see my garden! Noble is her endless magic, which often lifts my spirit-waves to the heights: What I love most is the surge of silver waves, and in their breaking foam, a music of silver bells. Those white foams, like a horse’s tail, can rival jewels once carved and set. A flawless full moon in a single shining disc, and besides, never diminished at all. If only I close these two eyes, then she will rise gracefully into the sky. Second day of the fourth month, deep night under the full moon.

paragraphs.source_zh:
我望見有兩個月亮：

一般的樣，不同的相。

一個這時正在天上，

披敞著雀毛的衣裳；

她不吝惜她的恩情，

滿地全是她的金銀。

她不忘故宮的琉璃，

三海間有她的清麗。

她跳出雲頭，跳上樹，

又躲進新綠的藤蘿。

她那樣玲瓏，那樣美，

水底的魚兒也得醉！

但她有一點子不好，

她老愛向瘦小裏耗；

有時滿天祗見星點，

沒了那迷人的圓臉，

雖則到時候照樣回來，

但這份相思有些難挨！

還有那個你看不見，

雖則不提有多麼艷！

她也有她醉渦的笑，

還有轉動時的靈妙；

說慷慨她也從不讓人，

可惜你望不到我的園林！

可貴是她無邊的法力，

常把我靈波向高裏提：

我最愛那銀濤的洶湧，

浪花裏有音樂的銀鐘；

就那些馬尾似的白沫，

也比得珠寶經過雕琢。

一輪完美的明月，

又況是永不殘缺！

祗要我閉上這一雙眼，

她就婷婷的升上了天！

四月二日圓月深夜
